# OpenPacks — vendors Pack

**Base System**: Posnic / MyCompany (offline)
**Pricing**: Free / Starter ($299–$599) / Managed ($9–$49/mo)

## Features
Offline-first POS, inventory, low-stock alerts, multi-event reporting

## Quick Install
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/praveenkay/OpenpacksAI/main/packages/vendors/install.sh | bash
```

## Manual
```bash
cd packages/vendors
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up -d
```
